profile.headline: Website Development and Support
profile.geoLocationName: Palisades Park, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: I believe one of my biggest strengths lie in my diverse professional experience and interests, through which I accumulated a strong work ethic and essential soft skills, such as adaptability and attention to detail. I'm eager to leverage these experiences in a new tech-related or operations role, where I can continue to grow as a professional in a goal-driven environment.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
● Collaborate with sales and web development teams to build customized websites for clients, delivering clear and insightful status reports for each completed account.
● Refine and optimize website components to ensure stylistic accuracy and functional alignment with client specifications, applying meticulous attention to detail and quality.
● Manage and resolve customer support inquiries and MLS data-mapping tickets within established deadlines, communicating progress and outcomes to internal teams and stakeholders through Jira, Helpdesk, and other project management tools.
positions.insights: Google Workspace, Web Design and +7 skills

positions.title: Production Associate
positions.description:
● Contribute around over 20 workstations to ensure smooth flow of the assembly process through an excellent understanding of the manufacture process for Model Y cars.
● Collaborate with supervisors and technical support team to quickly and precisely alert any machinery
malfunctions or part shortages to minimize the creation of defect parts and delays to assembly process.
● Ensure adherence to safety guidelines and procedures while maintaining a clean and orderly work environment.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
● Supervise up to 30 students during recreational and instructive times to ensure safety and academic standards were met.
● Coordinate supplementary curriculum to develop critical thinking and elevate the knowledge of
students.
● Accommodate flexible on-call hours based on the school.
● Draft weekly reports on progress for the students for internal use, allowing supervisors and parents to easily track students’ progress.

positions.title: Operations Team Member
positions.description:
● Ensure proper stocking of products on the floor and the backroom.
● Be on call to assist guests on the floor and at the registers.
● Handle the shipping process for online and pick-up orders.

volunteerExperiences.description: Registered books onto the library database through scanning RFID tags.

Worked with students from Chuo University, Japan, to deepen their understanding of American culture and language over the course of a month. Assisted in cross-cultural communication and organization of activities to explore the diverse culture at California State University, East Bay, and its surrounding areas.
